open_points.subject: Project-overview failure classification
open_points.text: “persistence and storage 500” and “the project overview answers a failed part as `temporarily_unavailable` with no value”
open_points.question: Which failures while building an overview component are converted to `temporarily_unavailable`, and which still fail the whole request with the normal HTTP error?
options: Convert only expected dependency failures such as Registry and persistence failures attributable to one component
Convert every declared failure attributable to a component
Convert only the specific Registry-context failure already described for the project component; propagate persistence failures as 500
open_points.default_guess: Convert Registry and persistence read failures attributable to one component, but propagate authentication, authorization, input, programming and un-attributable operation failures.

witness.initial: An authorized viewer requests an overview for a readable project whose expense repository raises `PersistenceError` while the expense component is read.
outcomes: The route follows the ordinary persistence mapping and returns HTTP 500 with no overview.
The route returns a successful `ProjectOverview` with `expenses_availability = temporarily_unavailable`, no expense value, and the other components present where available.

open_points.subject: Containment of overview component failures
open_points.text: “the project overview answers a failed part as `temporarily_unavailable` with no value”
open_points.question: How are component reads isolated so that one failed read can be represented while the remaining components continue, especially when the failure occurs while opening or using a transaction shared by more than one component?
options: Each overview component runs in its own independently guarded read transaction
The overview uses one transaction, so a transaction-level failure fails the whole overview while only component-local external failures are contained
A common read is shared, and every component depending on that failed read becomes `temporarily_unavailable`
open_points.default_guess: Run each independently available component in its own read transaction and fail the whole overview only when no component-specific transaction can be established.

witness.initial: An authorized project has an active budget, expenses, progress, payments and photos; opening or using the overview's portal transaction fails during the budget read.
events: The guard succeeds before overview construction.
The transaction used for the budget read fails and is rolled back under A22.
outcomes: Because the overview is one use case with one failed transaction, the original persistence failure is re-raised and the request returns 500.
The budget is marked `temporarily_unavailable`; independently isolated reads continue and the response contains the available expense, progress, payment and photo parts.
witness.observer: The staff member or viewer requesting the overview
